method:
Actual-game wildlife review at 30 Hz simulation / 15 fps normal playback.

Only completed predecessor quests and initial Caelan positions are fixtures.
Garden work/dialogue, animal behavior, the gardener's entire pasture visit,
player movement, contact sounds and Continue use production code. Site changes
between clips are labelled cuts. Music is muted; accepted regional effects are
rendered from the production PCM and gain stream without normalization.

markers.label: Garden care is complete; gardener begins her finite pasture visit
Caelan watches from beside the pasture gate
Sheep gather, investigate the one basket, and accept a pat
Save and Continue during the sheep and basket interaction
Continue preserves feet, basket and contact progress
Gardener hand contacts the sheep fleece; one quiet sheep cue
The same empty basket is lifted from the pasture
The gardener retrieves the basket and walks home; Caelan follows
